project_overview.name: DevAgent
project_overview.description: An autonomous software engineering agent based on large language models, supporting full lifecycle development from requirements analysis to code generation, testing, and repair, with real-time human review and Chinese documentation output.
key_deliverables: CLI tool with multiple task modes
REST API and WebSocket interactive service
30 specialized tools (Pipeline, code ops, GitHub, review)

phases.purpose: Define domain model, user stories, and acceptance criteria for DevAgent, including all modes, tools, and interaction flows.
key_challenges: Covering all 30 tools and their interactions
Defining clear acceptance criteria for each mode
quality_gates: All 30 tools identified with purpose and inputs/outputs
All CLI modes and parameters documented
Acceptance criteria for each mode measurable

phases.purpose: Design system architecture, module decomposition, and technology choices for DevAgent.
key_challenges: Designing the ReAct engine with tool orchestration
Real-time interaction via WebSocket and ThreadChannel
quality_gates: Data flow for each mode defined
WebSocket event types and payloads specified

phases.purpose: Implement the DevAgent codebase including agent core, tools, CLI, API, and VSCode extension.
key_challenges: Implementing the ReAct loop with tool execution

phases.purpose: Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests for DevAgent.
quality_gates: Unit test coverage >80% for core modules
Integration tests for each mode pass
End-to-end test for full pipeline works
No critical bugs in tool execution

risk_assessment.risk: LLM behavior unpredictability may cause inconsistent outputs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Implement robust error handling and fallback strategies; use deterministic prompts and validation layers.

risk_assessment.risk: WebSocket real-time interaction may have latency or disconnection issues
risk_assessment.mitigation: Implement reconnection logic and timeout handling; use heartbeat mechanism.
Target latest stable VSCode API; test on multiple versions.

risk_assessment.risk: Complexity of 30 tools may lead to integration issues
risk_assessment.mitigation: Define strict tool interface contracts; implement unit tests for each tool early.
